name: create_artifact
description: Create or update a complete deliverable in the Miyu-hosted Artifact workspace and show it in the WebUI immediately. Prefer this tool when the user explicitly asks for a report, document, web page, table, data file, standalone code file, or downloadable finished product. Call it only after the content is complete; do not call it for ordinary project source-code edits.

filename.description: Safe filename with the correct extension, e.g. report.md, index.html, or data.json; directories are not allowed.
